sporsmal.tekst: Why can a script in <head> without defer or async fail to find elements in the body?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: A script in <head> runs before the body has been parsed, so the elements it looks for do not exist in the DOM yet.

alternativer.tekst: Scripts in <head> do not have access to the document object
The browser blocks DOM access from <head> for security reasons
It runs before the body has been parsed, so the elements do not exist yet

sporsmal.tekst: What is the difference between event.target and event.currentTarget?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: event.target is the element where the event started, and event.currentTarget is the element the listener is attached to.

alternativer.tekst: target is where the event started; currentTarget is the element the listener is attached to
target is the element the listener is attached to; currentTarget is where the event started
target is always the document; currentTarget is the element that was clicked

sporsmal.tekst: Why does event delegation also work for list items that are added later?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: The listener sits on the list. Events from new items bubble up to it, so no new listeners are needed.

alternativer.tekst: addEventListener automatically attaches itself to new elements with the same tag
The listener is on the parent list, and events from new items bubble up to it
The browser runs all scripts again each time the DOM changes

sporsmal.tekst: Why is innerHTML dangerous with user input while textContent is not?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: innerHTML treats the string as HTML, so injected tags like may run code (XSS). textContent only sets text.

alternativer.tekst: innerHTML treats the string as HTML, so injected tags can run code; textContent only sets text
innerHTML saves the string permanently in the HTML source file
textContent removes all script elements from the page before it inserts the text

sporsmal.tekst: What is the difference between defer and async on a script?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: Both download in parallel. defer runs after the whole document has been parsed, in order; async runs as soon as the script is ready, in any order.

alternativer.tekst: defer downloads in parallel, while async stops parsing until the script has downloaded
async runs after parsing in document order, while defer runs as soon as the script is ready
Both download in parallel; defer runs after parsing in order, async runs when ready in any order

sporsmal.tekst: Why is it faster to insert many elements through a DocumentFragment?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: Each change to the DOM can make the browser recalculate the layout. A fragment lets you insert all the elements in one change.

alternativer.tekst: Elements in a fragment are protected against XSS
createElement cannot add elements directly to the page
Each DOM change can trigger a layout recalculation, and the fragment is inserted in one change

sporsmal.tekst: How does the NodeList from querySelectorAll differ from the HTMLCollection from getElementsByClassName?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: querySelectorAll returns a static NodeList, while getElementsByClassName returns a live HTMLCollection that updates when the document changes.

alternativer.tekst: The NodeList is live, while the HTMLCollection is static
The NodeList is static, while the HTMLCollection updates when the document changes
The NodeList holds only the first match, while the HTMLCollection holds all matches

sporsmal.tekst: Why does a submit handler often call event.preventDefault()?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: Calling preventDefault stops the normal form submission, so the script can send the data with fetch instead of reloading the page.

alternativer.tekst: So the script can send the data with fetch instead of reloading the page
So the submit event does not bubble up to the document
So all the fields are cleared before the data is sent

sporsmal.tekst: How do the input and change events differ on a text field?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: input fires on every keystroke, while change fires when the user leaves the field after changing it.

input fires on every keystroke, while change fires when the user leaves the field after changing it

sporsmal.tekst: In what sense is the DOM a live tree?

sporsmal.tekst: Why should a script move focus to an error message with element.focus()?

sporsmal.tekst: Which problem does a region with aria-live="polite" solve?
sporsmal.begrunnelse: When a script updates part of the page, screen readers may not notice. An aria-live="polite" region makes the screen reader announce the change.

sporsmal.tekst: What is the main drawback of using a <div> with a click listener instead of a <button>?
